effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] By trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
